cohort: 30 mothers of low-birth-weight babies and 60 mothers of normal-birth-weight babies
finding: Placental factors such as placental weight, length, breadth, diameter, surface area, thickness, and volume were lower, and microscopic and gross findings like hard areas, focal avascular villi, syncytial knotting, focal hyaline degeneration, and fibromuscular sclerosis were more prevalent in low-birth-weight babies compared to normal-birth-weight babies.
birth_weight: low birth weight and normal birth weight
